About Me

I’m an Electronics and Communication Engineering student focused on building robotics systems, embedded devices, and intelligent hardware-software integrations.

My work lies at the intersection of hardware, computation, and real-world automation, ranging from microcontroller based systems to vision enabled and connected devices.

I like projects that don’t just work in simulation, but survive contact with reality.
